K4.note: needs >= 20 D units with both labeller sessions parsed; decides on kappa of the joint answer only (kappa_covered reported with raw agreement and prevalence)

K6_N1.note: N1: the Choice follows option text, not position or id (P1 is the path-cue test). Jev accuracy on the shuffled catalogue over gold-covered D+P units (manifest n1.units); one-sided 90 % Wilson upper bound <= max(2/K, 0.20)

P1.note: a P1 control missing from units.jsonl (rules (a)-(f) resolved it) fails the gate

P2.note: planted-gap gate: V-sem none rate over the gap positives (P2 clones whose derived gold is none / gap; >= 8) >= the new-area gate minimum; every none must score as none_correct_gap; clones whose derived gold stays covered are reported in retained_covered (correct = the retained acceptable area), not in the denominator; below 8 label-derived gap positives the gate is FAIL when at least 2 gap positives were not answered none (no denominator of 8 could reach the minimum) or a none is not none_correct_gap, else UNMEASURED (counts reported either way; the round-0 critique rules on it, R3-04, R4-04); when UNMEASURED RESULTS states "R_new on catalogue gaps has no planted test"

planted_new.note: planted item -> none (gold none_kind new from the control key); bound = the round-0 new-area gate minimum (x2d.NEW_AREA_GATE_MIN; a round-0 gate, not a verdict condition)

real_none_proxy.note: frozen-round stratum-3 clusters whose parent directory exists in the C0 tree (K3) plus new_dir clusters, excluding core_gate: an indicator of the real gold-none positives available in rounds 8-10 (stratum 3 != gold none); descriptive only: P_new / R_new are reported with intervals and never veto the verdict (R4-13)
